name: Shape Elements
description:
You are able to shape the elements at-will, as a free action, to cause minor effects within short range:

  • Air. You may cause a small, focused puff of wind, cause gentle movements of air, or create an area of stillness.

  • Water. You may move or levitate up to a gallon of water, cause small waves in a body of water, or stop or accelerate the flow of a small stream.

  • Darkness. You may halve the brightness of a single light source, create a small area of shade in sunlight, or partially obscure an area no larger than you.

  • Fire. You may light or snuff a candle, torch or small campfire, create a small flame in your palm, or warm and object you're holding.

  • Earth. You may shift, shape or levitate stones or sections of stone up to 10 lbs.

The GM may allow you to achieve other effects of similar scale, at their discretion.
